description: Gems (docs/draft/gem-system.md). Generated at --migrate into items: gem-<type>-<size>-uncut, gem-<type>-<size>-<quality>, and ring-/necklace-<type>-<size>-<quality>. A gem's value is base_value x the size multiplier (x the quality multiplier once cut); its rarity follows the value. Curves are [x, value] points, interpolated log-linearly between points and held flat past the ends. type_tilt and size_tilt reweight the type and size rolls: weight = drop_rate x tilt ^ log10(base_value / 1000) for types, and drop_rate x tilt ^ log10(multiplier) for sizes. A tilt of 1 leaves the base drop_rates alone; below 1 favours cheap/small gems, above 1 valuable/large ones.

drops._comment: Per kill, by the monster's challenge rating. A monster's own gem_chance overrides gem_chance; no_gem_types carry none unless they set one.

mining._comment: Gem cells at a rock face, by the face's tier (mining-system.md section 6). A seam's gems.types replaces the type weights with its own leaning.

jeweller._comment: Cutting costs the size's cut_fee and reveals the quality (rolled at the cut). Setting a cut gem takes the piece's gold plus labour x the cut gem's value; the piece is worth its gold plus the gem.
